Plague of UndeathRank 1
30 Runic Power
1.5 sec cast
Disease an enemy dealing 32+0+ShaP*0.25 Plague damage every 2.5 sec and reduces the targets Holy healing received by 40% for 20 sec.

If Plague of Undeath is dispelled, the enemy takes 80+9.0 Points Per Level+ShaP*1.25 Plague damage and is stunned for 5 sec.

Periodic damage dealt by this benefits from your spell haste.
